plugins.name: memoryrelay
plugins.description: MemoryRelay for Claude Code: loads the repository's bound ICM context and its memories at session start, asks for the read and outcome report at stop, stores durable findings after a compaction, and keeps secrets out of stored memories. Connects to https://api.memoryrelay.net/mcp with MEMORYRELAY_API_KEY. Source: memoryrelay/api plugins/memoryrelay.
